schema_note: v0.6 unified field note schema. Builds on v0.5 schema (16 fields) by adding 4 fields for real input pipeline (input_id, input_metadata, consent, audit_trail).
boundary: v0.6 only DOCUMENTS this schema. Real input pipeline (UI form / CLI / API endpoint) is NOT delivered in v0.6. Implementation by P5-E.
manual_method_filed_p_step: Step 1: Fieldworker drafts note in Markdown with YAML frontmatter matching this schema
Step 2: Fieldworker or curator commits note to /data/field_notes/incoming/ folder
Step 3: Pipeline script (P5-E only) validates schema, validates place_id, validates citation_ids
Step 4: On success, note moves to /data/field_notes.json and gets linked to workspace + research_questions
Step 5: v0.6+ site rebuilds; note appears on /field-notes/ page

required_fields.name: field_note_id
required_fields.note: deterministic ID, server-assigned or manual pre-allocated

required_fields.name: place_id
required_fields.format: must match places.json place_id (e.g. sangganhe, beijing, grand_canal)

optional_fields.name: photos_count
optional_fields.note: no actual photo files in v0.6; only count

v0_6_new_fields.name: input_id
v0_6_new_fields.note: audit trail ID — assigned by input pipeline (P5-E)

validation_rules: field_note_id must be globally unique across all field_notes.json records
place_id must exist in places.json (canonical, no prefix)
all linked_citation_ids must match SHUGE:p<post_id>:<page_seq> format and exist in citations.json
linked_evidence_card_ids and research_question_ids are optional, but if present must exist
verification_status must be one of 4 enum values
photos_count must be integer ≥0; actual photos not stored in v0.6
gps_lat/gps_lng must be valid WGS84 lat/lng range if provided
yaml_frontmatter_example:
```yaml
---
field_note_id: FN-20261001-001
place_id: beijing
date: '2026-10-01'
location_text: 北京市东城区故宫博物院 太和殿前檐柱
gps_lat: 39.9163
gps_lng: 116.3972
weather: 晴
photos_count: 12
recording_count: 1
fieldworker_name: 张三
linked_citation_ids:
  - SHUGE:p44159:100
  - SHUGE:p44159:200
linked_research_question_ids:
  - rq-ws2-001
verification_status: VERIFIED
tags:
  - pillar-measurement
  - d-equals-2c
---

# 太和殿前檐柱测量

实测太和殿前檐柱直径约 0.6m,柱顶石正心面直径约 0.3m...
```
